passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 9.1
passages.text: te, Moeri, pedes? an, quo via ducit, in urbem?

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 9.2
passages.text: O Lycida, vivi pervenimus, advena nostri

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 9.3
passages.text: (quod numquam veriti sumus) ut possessor agelli

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 9.4
passages.text: diceret: “Haec mea sunt; veteres migrate coloni!”

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 9.5
passages.text: nunc victi, tristes, quoniam Fors omnia versat,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 9.6
passages.text: hos illi—quod nec vertat bene—mittimus haedos.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 9.7
passages.text: Certe equidem audieram, qua se subducere colles

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 9.8
passages.text: incipiunt, mollique iugum demittere clivo,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 9.9
passages.text: usque ad aquam et veteres (iam fracta cacumina) fagos

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 9.10
passages.text: omnia carminibus vestrum servasse Menalcan.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 9.11
passages.text: Audieras, et fama fuit; sed carmina tantum

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 9.12
passages.text: nostra valent, Lycida, tela inter Martia, quantum

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 9.13
passages.text: Chaonias dicunt aquila veniente columbas.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 9.14
passages.text: quod nisi me quacumque novas incidere lites

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 9.15
passages.text: ante Sinistra cava monuisset ab ilice cornix,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 9.16
passages.text: nec tuus hic Moeris, nec viveret ipse Menalcas.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 9.17
passages.text: Heu, cadit in quemquam tantum scelus? Heu, tua nobis

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 9.18
passages.text: paene simul tecum solatia rapta, Menalca?

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 9.19
passages.text: quis caneret nymphas; quis humum florentibus herbis

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 9.20
passages.text: spargeret, aut viridi fontes induceret umbra?

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 9.21
passages.text: vel quae sublegi tacitus tibi carmina nuper,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 9.22
passages.text: cum te ad delicias ferres, Amaryllida, nostras?

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 9.23
passages.text: Tityre, dum redeo—brevis est via—pasce capellas,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 9.24
passages.text: et potum pastas age, Tityre, et inter agendum

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 9.25
passages.text: occursare capro, cornu ferit ille, caveto.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 9.26
passages.text: Immo haec, quae Varo necdum perfecta canebat:

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 9.27
passages.text: “Vare, tuum nomen, superet modo Mantua nobis—

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 9.28
passages.text: Mantua, vae miserae nimium vicina Cremonae—

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 9.29
passages.text: cantantes sublime ferent ad sidera cycni.”

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 9.30
passages.text: Sic tua Cyrneas fugiant examina taxos;

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 9.31
passages.text: sic cytiso pastae distendant ubera vaccae!

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 9.32
passages.text: Incipe, si quid habes: et me fecere poetam

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 9.33
passages.text: Pierides; sunt et mihi carmina; me quoque dicunt

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 9.34
passages.text: vatem pastores, sed non ego credulus illis.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 9.35
passages.text: Nam neque adhuc Vario videor, nec dicere Cinna

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 9.36
passages.text: digna, sed argutos inter strepere anser olores.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 9.37
passages.text: Id quidem ago et tacitus, Lycida, mecum ipse voluto,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 9.38
passages.text: si valeam meminisse; neque est ignobile carmen:

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 9.39
passages.text: `huc ades, O Galatea; quis est nam ludus in undis

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 9.40
passages.text: hic ver purpureum; varios hic flumina circum

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 9.41
passages.text: fundit humus flores; hic candida populus antro

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 9.42
passages.text: imminet, et lentae texunt umbracula vites.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 9.43
passages.text: huc ades: insani feriant sine litora fluctus.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 9.44
passages.text: Quid, quae te pura solum sub nocte canentem

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 9.45
passages.text: audieram? Numeros memini, si verba tenerem.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 9.46
passages.text: “Daphni, quid antiquos signorum suspicis ortus?

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 9.47
passages.text: Ecce Dionaei processit Caesaris astrum,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 9.48
passages.text: astrum, quo segetes gauderent frugibus, et quo

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 9.49
passages.text: duceret apricis in collibus uva colorem.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 9.50
passages.text: insere, Daphni, piros: carpent tua poma nepotes.”

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 9.51
passages.text: Omnia fert aetas, animum quoque: saepe ego longos

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 9.52
passages.text: cantando puerum memini me condere soles:

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 9.53
passages.text: nunc oblita mihi tot carmina; vox quoque Moerim

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 9.54
passages.text: iam fugit ipsa; lupi Moerim videre priores.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 9.55
passages.text: Sed tamen ista satis referet tibi saepe Menalcas.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 9.56
passages.text: Causando nostros in longum ducis amores:

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 9.57
passages.text: et nunc omne tibi stratum silet aequor, et omnes,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 9.58
passages.text: aspice, ventosi ceciderunt murmuris aurae.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 9.59
passages.text: hinc adeo media est nobis via; namque sepulcrum

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 9.60
passages.text: incipit adparere Bianoris: hic ubi densas

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 9.61
passages.text: agricolae stringunt frondes, hic, Moeri, canamus;

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 9.62
passages.text: hic haedos depone: tamen veniemus in urbem.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 9.63
passages.text: aut si, nox pluviam ne colligat ante, veremur,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 9.64
passages.text: cantantes licet usque (minus via laedit) eamus;

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 9.65
passages.text: cantantes ut eamus, ego hoc te fasce levabo.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 9.66
passages.text: Desine plura, puer, et quod nunc instat agamus:

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 9.67
passages.text: carmina tum melius, cum venerit ipse, canemus.
